high_level_description: This image captures a lively concert scene featuring the artist Dua Lipa. The setting is an outdoor stage with a large crowd of people gathered to watch the performance. The stage is illuminated with bright lights, creating a vibrant and energetic atmosphere. The backdrop of the stage prominently displays the name "DUA LIPA" in bold white letters against a dark background. The crowd consists of numerous individuals, mostly standing close together, facing the stage. Some people are wearing casual summer attire, such as t-shirts, jeans, and dresses, indicating warm weather.
